verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Web as a first-class supported platform with running WASM+WebGL examples in browser (bevy-docs-6, bevy-docs-16, bevy-docs-34), and community commentary confirms web support is a real draw (bevy-comm-20). However, the evidence pack contains no mention of WebGPU support or payload-size considerations, leaving that half of the story unaddressed. Missing for 10: explicit WebGPU backend documentation/examples, payload-size/optimization guidance, independent benchmarks of browser performance.
